⚽ WC Matches
Dom. wins — the team that completed more raw passes also won the match.
Upset — the team that completed more raw passes lost the match; passing more didn't translate into winning.
Close — the composite passing score (blending pass volume, density, progressive passes, final-third entries, and key passes) was nearly even between the two teams (45–55%) — no clear passing-quality edge either way.
